name: Markdown
description: Renders a Markdown source as sanitized HTML: GitHub Flavored Markdown by default, raw HTML only through an allowlist.

children.description: Markdown source, rendered as HTML that never carries scripts, styles, event handlers or unsafe URLs.

gfm.description: GitHub Flavored Markdown as in GitHub comments: tables, task lists, strikethrough, autolinks, a line break as a break; `false` parses plain CommonMark.

html.description: Render raw HTML in the source through an allowlist of text and block tags (no scripts, styles, forms, frames or attributes that run code); otherwise it shows as typed.

linkTarget.description: Where links to other sites (http(s) and protocol-relative URLs) open; relative links, anchors and mailto/tel links always open in place.

linkRel.description: `rel` of every link to another site, whatever its target, such as `nofollow ugc noopener` for user content; an empty string adds none.

membrane.description: Wrap the block in the 1px outer spacing box that Face UI controls share, to line it up with controls in a row.

notes: Markdown is an approved rich-text exception: generated headings, paragraphs, lists and tables cannot route every node through Text.
Inline code and code blocks use mono typography tokens; code blocks read left to right in any direction.
A task checkbox hangs into the list's inline-start padding, taking its bullet's place.
